Current state: Security strategy references patient safety and clinic uptime; approved by the CEO in March 2026.
Recommendation: Keep annual review tied to the strategic plan.

Current state: Risk appetite statement drafted but not yet approved by the board's audit committee.
Recommendation: Present the appetite statement (residual ≤ 9 on the 5×5 scale) for audit committee approval.

Current state: CISO reports quarterly to the executive team; risk owners are named in the risk register.
Recommendation: Add risk-owner attestations to the quarterly report.

Current state: Information security policy approved in 2024; 3 of 14 supporting standards are overdue for review and no AI policy exists.
Recommendation: Refresh the overdue standards and publish an AI acceptable-use policy.

Current state: No formal review of whether the strategy reduces risk; reporting is activity-based (tickets closed).
Recommendation: Report residual-risk trend and KRI results to the executive team each quarter.

Current state: Vendor reviews happen at onboarding only; there is no tiering method and no reassessment schedule.
Recommendation: Adopt the tiering model from the TPRM workstream and reassess Tier 1 vendors annually.

Current state: Intune and AWS Config cover managed endpoints and cloud resources; clinic kiosks and lab devices are tracked in a spreadsheet.
Recommendation: Bring kiosks into a single CMDB fed by Intune, AWS Config and network discovery.

Current state: No inventory of SaaS applications outside SSO; 9 known apps provisioned by hand.
Recommendation: Use CASB discovery to build the SaaS inventory and assign business owners.

Current state: PHI flows for the EHR hub are diagrammed; telehealth and claims flows are not.
Recommendation: Document PHI flows for telehealth and claims, including third-party transfers.

Current state: Weekly authenticated scanning of servers and cloud; endpoints and containers scanned monthly.
Recommendation: Extend weekly scanning to container images in the registry.

Current state: Enterprise risk register rebuilt in FY2026 with likelihood and impact scoring; not yet used for budget decisions.
Recommendation: Link the FY2027 security budget requests to register risk IDs.

Current state: Audit and pen-test findings tracked in separate spreadsheets with no consolidated view.
Recommendation: Consolidate all findings into one POA&M with owners and due dates.

Current state: Entra ID is the identity source; 11 static secrets found in code repositories.
Recommendation: Rotate exposed secrets and move non-human credentials to a vault.

Current state: MFA for all users; 14 privileged users on push MFA; legacy auth allowed for 3 shared mailboxes.
Recommendation: Require phishing-resistant MFA for privileged roles and block legacy authentication.

Current state: Quarterly user access reviews completed for Entra groups; AWS IAM and the support console are never reviewed.
Recommendation: Add AWS IAM roles and the support console to the quarterly review.

Current state: Annual training with 97% completion; monthly phishing simulations (click rate fell from 14% to 6%).
Recommendation: Add role-based modules for finance and support staff.

Current state: KMS encryption on all RDS and S3 PHI stores; BitLocker on 96% of laptops.
Recommendation: Close the BitLocker gap through Conditional Access.

Current state: CIS baselines applied to Windows servers; no baseline or drift detection for Linux or AWS accounts.
Recommendation: Adopt CIS AWS Foundations as the account baseline with AWS Config conformance packs.

Current state: VPC Flow Logs enabled but not sent to the SIEM; no network detection on the clinic VPN.
Recommendation: Ingest VPC Flow Logs and VPN logs into the SIEM with baseline alerts.

Current state: Support-console record views logged but never reviewed; no UEBA.
Recommendation: Run a weekly anomaly report on record access and review it.

Current state: Vendor VPN sessions are not logged centrally; no alerts on vendor access outside contracted hours.
Recommendation: Log and alert on all vendor remote sessions.

Current state: Outsourced SOC triages EDR alerts 24/7 with a 30-minute SLA; cloud alerts handled ad hoc by engineers.
Recommendation: Route GuardDuty and Entra ID Protection alerts to the SOC queue.

Current state: SIEM receives 23 of 37 required sources; correlation rules exist for EDR only.
Recommendation: Onboard the 14 missing sources and build cross-source detections.

Description: Event information shared with the right people
Current state: SOC escalates to the on-call engineer by phone; escalation paths for privacy and legal are not defined.
Recommendation: Define escalation criteria that bring in the Privacy Officer and legal for suspected PHI events.

Description: Incident response plan executed with third parties
Current state: IR plan approved in 2025; does not include the outsourced SOC's role or vendor notification contacts.
Recommendation: Update the plan with SOC, cyber insurer and key vendor contacts; run a joint tabletop.

Current state: Triage criteria and severity matrix documented; used consistently in the 2026 incident log.
Recommendation: Review the severity matrix annually.

Current state: Root-cause analysis done for 2 of 9 Severity 2+ incidents in the last 12 months.
Recommendation: Require a post-incident review for every Severity 2+ incident within 10 business days.

Current state: HIPAA breach notification procedure exists; no template or decision log for the four-factor risk assessment.
Recommendation: Create a breach-assessment template that documents the four-factor analysis and notification decision.

Current state: EDR isolation is used routinely; no documented containment steps for compromised cloud identities.
Recommendation: Write playbooks for compromised Entra accounts and AWS access keys.

Current state: Eradication steps follow vendor guidance case by case; no verification step before closure.
Recommendation: Add a verification checklist and second-person sign-off before incident closure.

Current state: Recovery is part of the IR plan but has never been exercised end to end.
Recommendation: Run a full recovery exercise for one Tier 1 service in Q1 2027.

Current state: No agreed restore order across services; BIA tiers drafted in FY2026.
Recommendation: Approve the BIA tiers and publish a restore sequence.

Current state: Backups are not checked for integrity or malware before restore; no immutable copy exists.
Recommendation: Enable Vault Lock, scan restore points before use, and record the result.

Current state: No criteria for declaring recovery complete or for running in degraded mode.
Recommendation: Define degraded-mode procedures and exit criteria for Tier 1 services.

Current state: The communications plan covers employees only; clinic customers are contacted ad hoc.
Recommendation: Add clinic-customer status updates with fixed intervals to the comms plan.

Current state: No pre-approved public statement templates; media handled by the CEO's office.
Recommendation: Prepare holding statements approved by legal and communications.
